Frequently asked questions.
Everything you need to know before choosing a workshop or bringing AI 360° to your campus or organisation.
Who are AI 360° workshops designed for?
Students, educators, working professionals, researchers and organisational teams. The pace, examples and tool mix are adapted to each audience.
Do I need prior AI or technical experience?
No. Complete beginners and advanced users can participate in the same workshop through guided foundations and optional stretch activities.
Are the workshops live or pre-recorded?
All core workshops are live and mentor-led, with practical exercises, questions and feedback throughout the session.
Which AI tools will I learn?
The exact mix depends on your level and goals. Programs may include ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, NotebookLM, n8n, Google AI Studio and specialist research tools.
Do I need paid subscriptions for the tools?
No. Free versions cover the Basic and Intermediate workshops in full. We will let you know in advance if an optional specialist tool is recommended.
Will I receive a certificate?
Yes. Participants who complete the workshop activities receive a certificate of completion from AI 360°.
Can colleges or organisations request a custom workshop?
Yes. We tailor the curriculum, examples and delivery format around your learners, roles and desired outcomes.
Still have a question? Talk to us
